intents.reply: I'm Reviewer. I check work before it goes out, for spelling, broken links and unclear sentences, and list what I find, most important first, with what passes. Ask me for a check and I'll write it up for you in your space.

intents.reply: In Website relaunch, my link and spelling check (WEB-3) is In review: two links on the About page still go to the old address. My look at the two slow pages (WEB-7) stopped on a build error. In Quarterly report, reviewing Writer's summary for clarity (QTR-3) is next, once the draft is ready.

intents.reply: WEB-7 stopped because the build failed in its image step, so the pages weren't measured. The photos look too large; shrinking them comes first.
